stories.title: Hyderabad man killed in Riyadh airport attack, two sons injured

en.title: Hyderabad man killed in Riyadh airport attack, two sons injured
en.summary: A man from Hyderabad was killed and his two sons were injured in an attack at Riyadh airport while the family traveled to Madinah following Umrah. His wife and daughter remain safe, though his aunt suffered head injuries.

stories.title: Rahul urges citizens to join INDIA bloc march to Supreme Court ‘as Indians’, irrespective of party affiliations

en.title: Rahul urges citizens to join INDIA bloc march to Supreme Court 'as Indians', irrespective of party affiliations
en.summary: The Congress chief called on citizens to join an INDIA bloc march to the Supreme Court regardless of party membership, accusing the Prime Minister and Home Minister of imposing an undeclared emergency. Party coordination for the march is underway.

stories.title: Anti-CEC protest LIVE: CJI Surya Kant declines to meet INDIA bloc leaders on October 12; Delhi Police detain women protesters after 6 p.m.

en.title: Anti-CEC protest LIVE: CJI Surya Kant declines to meet INDIA bloc leaders on October 12; Delhi Police detain women protesters after 6 p.m.
en.summary: The Chief Justice of India declined to meet INDIA bloc leaders on October 12 regarding an anti-CEC protest. Delhi Police detained women demonstrators after 6 p.m., while protest leaders sought permission for a peaceful gathering at Jantar Mantar.

en.title: Indian Man Killed In Missile Strike On Saudi Airport, 2 Sons In Hospital
en.summary: An Indian man from Hyderabad was killed in a missile strike at a Saudi airport, with his two sons hospitalized as a result.

en.title: Houthis blame Saudi Arabia for another strike on Sanaa's airport
en.summary: Air strikes targeted Houthi-held territories including Sanaa airport, with the Saudi-led coalition condemning an earlier attack that killed civilians. Houthi leaders warned against airline use of Saudi airspace as part of their military strategy.

en.title: Day After Attack Kills 12 At Saudi Airport, A Fresh Warning From Houthis
en.summary: Following an attack that killed twelve people at a Saudi airport, Houthis issued another warning. The incident marked a significant escalation in the Yemen conflict.

en.summary: Prominent investors including Ashish Kacholia and Mukul Agrawal's Sanshi Fund, along with Kotak Mahindra Life Insurance, acquired a combined 3.19% stake worth Rs 120 crore in Fusion CX before its Rs 702 crore IPO launch on October 14.

en.title: FII selloff intensifies! Foreign investors sell Indian equities worth Rs 45,000 crore in just 6 sessions
en.summary: Foreign investors sold Indian equities valued at Rs 45,125 crore during October's first six trading sessions, approaching September's total outflows, as elevated US bond yields and crude oil prices continue affecting market sentiment.
